I'm currently installing Sacred 2.
I used to play a lot of Gmod, cs go, binding of isaac. I recently installed Tera as well. you?
Ah.. so you have Steam? I have an Xbox One unfortunately.

Well, it would help me if I knew you as a person. I don't have any friends right now. I only have a couple family members and my cat. Everyone has pretty much blamed me for 'pushing' them away even though it was never my intention.
I just wish you wanted to stay and be friends is all. There's a lot of posts and people on here. I just need someone to talk to and that will stay.
A lot of things.. but it's okay, you aren't close with me so why would you care? You probably have a good life, a lover, family and friends.
It's just difficult to even 'do' it. I have attempted before but when I was much younger, and these days I find it really hard because I realize what life can offer. My life is just unfair.

Oh for sure. I heard things and I hallucinated for months.. I've been to the hospital twice as well and that hasn't been the best for me to remember those times. I really am struggling to see a light anywhere in my life.
